locations.description:
Bring any trash you've picked up on Aloha Beach over to Yoko Umino - you can exchange them for **recycle points** depending on their type. Recycle points can then be exchanged for items.

- Cans: 10 points
- Plastic bottles: 30 points
- Magazines: 50 points
- Glass bottles: 100 points
